scope.summary: Author the thigh/leg channels per Section 13.17 (BK-17.3, TAI-BK-045), closing REQ-013 and OBR-004's long-legs target: thigh_girth_inner and thigh_girth_outer as split Tissue axes, thigh_gap, calf_girth, and leg_length as a Skeletal/Tissue hybrid via per-bone scale (13.18 lane) with automatic joint re-derivation — leg length independent of leg thickness.
acceptance_criteria: thigh_girth_inner and thigh_girth_outer are separate registered Tissue channels over thigh_inner_l/r and thigh_outer_l/r masks respectively; thigh_gap and calf_girth are Tissue channels over their masks; leg_length is registered kind Skeletal driving thigh/calf bone scale with propagation declared.

leg_length changes route through the 13.18 joint re-derivation hook (bone lengths change, joint centers re-derive); thigh girth channels change zero bone lengths (thickness != length, TAI-BK-059 interplay).
Full-range sweeps of every channel pass BODY_DECOUPLE_VALID: thigh channels move zero glute-mask and zero hip-mask vertices; leg_length moves zero girth-mask deltas.
Long-legs + narrow-thighs + round-ass sample (OBR-004): leg_length at max + thigh girths at min + glute_volume at max evaluates artifact-free at the glute/thigh crease.
All five channels API-addressable; leg_length surfaces in cm with mm authority conversion.
scope.risk_if_missed: Daz needs third-party proportion packs plus manual rig adjustment for exactly these axes; without split girth axes and length-vs-thickness independence, the operator's long-legs/narrow-thighs archetypes force rig surgery per body.

gui_obligation.not_applicable_reason: Backend/solver scope: behavior is observable via TraceProjection, typed TAILOR_BODY_* receipts, and the 13.12 capture APIs; operator/model GUI exposure rides the BodyKit panes (13.27) and is validated there.

hbr_int_009_tier_obligations.reason: Emits/extends the TAILOR_BODY_* KernelEventType family on the EventLedger per Section 13.16 (extends the 13.14 canonical list).
internal_diagnostics ships with WP-KERNEL-012; wire the open diagnostic-event API for this behavior in the WP-KERNEL-016 retrofit.
Palmistry external watcher ships with WP-KERNEL-012/016; long generation/bake/export runs get child-stall watch coverage in the retrofit.

risks: Broad MT scope can hide multiple review targets.
Markdown MT lists may disagree with packet-declared active/next MT truth.
Receipt routing may target an old MT if contract identity is omitted.
minimum_controls: Exactly one primary proof target per MT unless the packet records why not.
MT identity must be stable and referenced by receipt correlation.
Generated projection drift must not wake Coder or Validator by itself.
